title: U.S. judge says Ethereum has ‘no terms of use,’ clears MIT brothers of $25 million fraud
content: A federal judge acquitted Anton and James Peraire-Bueno, ruling that their 2023 trade against Ethereum trading bots involved no lie that anyone relied on, and closing the U.S. government’s first criminal case over the practice known as MEV.

title: Bitcoin's 12% slide through key support looks scary, but history says give it 3 months.
content: Bitcoin broke below its 200-week average with a 12% drop. Only three similar crashes have occurred since 2013. Here’s what happened next.

title: XRP whales moved $270 million during the selloff. The coins didn’t go to exchanges
content: A holder whose wallets trace back to a 2020 Bitstamp withdrawal has moved 281 million XRP into two vaults three weeks apart, a behavior indicative of custody rather than a large investor heading for the exit.

title: CFTC nominee questions public benefit of prediction markets as legal fight grows
content: One of the two picks to join the regulatory commission, Democratic nominee Matthew Rowland, said he hopes to have a say in prediction markets rulemaking.

title: Nvidia shares rise on earnings beat, raised outlook despite leadership uncertainty
content: Speaking on the earnings call, Chairman Harvey Jones said the board has no intention of reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO.

title: Ledger hardware implant saga reaches Dubai’s Virgin Megastore
content: Two Ledger owners reported losing a combined $604,000 in crypto from hardware wallets they said were purchased at authorized retailer Virgin Megastore in Dubai.

title: Nvidia board rejects Huang comeback despite record $116B quarter
content: Nvidia beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations by 5.6% and issued a stronger-than-expected sales forecast, while its board resisted growing calls for Jensen Huang’s reinstatement.

title: CFTC halts some Kalshi Trump mention markets over manipulation concerns
content: The CFTC stayed Kalshi’s Trump-related mention markets after raising concerns about manipulation risks, giving the platform until Dec. 11 to defend its contracts.

title: Maple Finance CEO targets up to $15B in assets by the end of 2027
content: Sidney Powell aims to reach $15 billion in assets under management by the end of 2027 as the firm looks to expand into tokenized lending and traditional finance.

title: Eastern Europe crypto flows fall 7.9% as Ukraine draws $12B in stablecoins
content: Chainalysis found that Eastern Europe recorded the steepest decline in crypto activity of any region, while cross-border stablecoin transfers to Ukraine continued amid the ongoing war.

title: Why Microsoft Thinks Smaller, Cheaper AI Can Beat Claude and GPT
content: Microsoft's new coding, cybersecurity and image models challenge bigger rivals on performance and price. The company's bet is that doing one job exceptionally well matters more than doing absolutely everything.

title: Nvidia Board Shuts Down Jensen Huang Comeback, Launches Search for New CEO
content: Nvidia's board rejected a comeback for its ousted co-founder as it hired a search firm, backed interim CEO Colette Kress, and tightened oversight of chip exports to China.

title: Nvidia Shares Rise After Earnings Beat in First Report Since Jensen Huang's Exit
content: The chipmaker doubled quarterly revenue, forecast another record and rallied after hours, but its first report without Jensen Huang leaves leadership questions and a deeply bruised stock chart unresolved.

title: OpenAI's GPT 6.2 Astra Challenges Anthropic on Price, But Not Every Benchmark
content: OpenAI's latest models promise better professional work for less money, as the company battles Anthropic and Google for AI supremacy and faces tougher questions about increasingly capable systems and safety.

title: World Bank Taps Circle and Citi to Test Stablecoins for Development Payments
content: The institution will test whether Circle’s USDC and blockchain rails can speed up and cut the cost of disbursing development funds.
